@locale.description: BCP 47 language tag for this locale.

@language_name.description: Endonym / native name of the language as displayed in the language selector.

@title.description: Main game title displayed on the title screen banner.

@subtitle.description: Game tagline / subtitle summarizing the genre: tactical turn-based strategy on a graph board.

@board_variant.description: Section header on the title screen for selecting the board layout / ruleset.

@variant_classic.description: Name of the traditional Fox & Hounds board variant. Board rules: hounds only move forward.

@variant_classic_sub.description: Historical subtitle for the classic board variant (traditionally known as the French Military Game).

@variant_river_crossing.description: Name of the alternative board variant featuring river bridges and free hound movement.

@variant_river_crossing_sub.description: Rule subtitle for the River Crossing variant: hounds are allowed to walk backwards.

@variant_fox_and_dogs.description: Name of the Fox and dogs board variant with 3 dogs and bridge.

@variant_fox_and_dogs_sub.description: Rule subtitle for the Fox and dogs variant: dogs move first.

@choose_faction.description: Section header on the title screen prompting the player to choose their side (Fox or Hounds).

@fox_title.description: Faction button label for playing as the Fox. Keep the fox emoji prefix.

@fox_subtitle.description: Short objective shown under the Fox faction button: reach the chicken coop on the opposite side. Note: 'Coop' refers to a chicken coop, not cooperative multiplayer.

@hounds_title.description: Faction button label for playing as the Hounds. Keep the hound emoji prefix.

@hounds_subtitle.description: Short objective shown under the Hounds faction button: surround and immobilize the Fox. 'Trap' is an imperative verb.

@ai_difficulty.description: Section header on the title screen for selecting opponent AI difficulty.

@difficulty_easy.description: Option label for Easy AI difficulty level.

@difficulty_medium.description: Option label for Medium (standard) AI difficulty level.

@difficulty_hard.description: Option label for Hard (minimax) AI difficulty level.

@start_match.description: Main call-to-action button on the title screen to start the game.

@fox_turn.description: HUD status text indicating it is currently the Fox player's turn to move.

@hounds_turn.description: HUD status text indicating it is currently the Hounds player's turn to move.

@thinking.description: HUD status text shown while the AI opponent is calculating its move.

@victory.description: Modal header banner shown when the player wins the match.

@defeat.description: Modal header banner shown when the player loses the match.

game_over.fox_won_msg: 🦊 The Fox reached the Chicken Coop!

@fox_won_msg.description: Victory/defeat explanation when the Fox wins by escaping to the opposite goal line (chicken coop). Keep the fox emoji prefix.

game_over.hounds_won_msg: 🐶 The Hounds encircled and trapped the Fox!

@hounds_won_msg.description: Victory/defeat explanation when the Hounds win by leaving the Fox with no legal moves. Keep the hound emoji prefix.

@stats_template.description: Match summary line on the game over modal showing total turns, AI difficulty, and board variant.

@play_again.description: Button label on the game over modal to restart the match with the same settings.

@main_menu.description: Button label on the game over modal to return to the title screen.
